heading: Modification of agreements; compromise, waiver or release
lead: The Secretary may agree to modifications of agreements made under this part, and may compromise, waive, or release any right, title, claim, or demand of the United States arising or acquired under this part.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2010—Pub. L. 111–148 substituted “this part” for “this subpart” in two places. 1975—Pub. L. 94–63, § 941(h)(1), (4)(C), substituted “subpart” for “part” in two places and struck out “or loans” after “agreements”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1975 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 94–63 effective July 1, 1975, see section 942 of Pub. L. 94–63, set out as a note under section 297a of this title.
